name: Gustling
notes: Gustling: a round blue chick with a white face and belly, an orange beak and a head crest. Type FLYING: it always flies, wings flapping and feet tucked away, in every animation (the look), and that makes it harder to hit: every move aimed at it, the player's, a wild monster's or the Alpha's, in every mode, has 10 % less accuracy (evasion 10: a 100 % move hits 90 %, a 95 % move 85 %; ground zones and status-only moves still never miss). Moves: Gust (A), Peck (B) and Fly (R). Walks at 80 % speed: its move 1 (Gust) reaches 3 tiles, and the farther a monster's move 1 reaches, the slower it walks. It can be the player, and the 8 species that aren't picked live on the map.
title: GUSTLING
